overview: This brief joint session of the Marathon County EEED and HRFC committees emerged from a closed session, with staff announcing they had received direction on next steps for evaluating proposals and beginning lease negotiations with the Marathon Center for Arts and Culture. The EEED Committee then adjourned, and the HRFC Committee took a brief recess. Any resulting agreements will require approval from the appropriate committees and the full board.
committee: Marathon County EEED & HRFC Committee (Joint Meeting)
presiding: Chair Marash (name mentioned but full name not clearly identified in transcript)

agenda.item: Announcement from closed session regarding proposals and lease negotiations

discussions.item: Closed Session Announcement — Proposals and MCAC Lease Direction
discussions.body: Staff announced that, following closed session, committees provided direction on next steps for engaging each of the submitted proposals for potential negotiation. Additionally, staff were directed to begin lease negotiations with the Marathon Center for Arts and Culture (MCAC). A speaker — identified as Chair Marash — emphasized that any resulting agreement must return to the appropriate committees and to the full board for approval before taking effect.

A motion to adjourn the EEED Committee was made by Supervisor Cabell and seconded by Supervisor Foot. The motion passed on a voice vote with no opposition. The HRFC Committee then announced a brief five-minute recess, with a note that an ERC meeting was scheduled to begin at 2:30.
